name: markdown-view
title: Markdown View
description: Renders Markdown (CommonMark, GFM tables, tasks and strikethrough, and [[wikilinks]]) to React elements with the Lezer parser, fenced code as a highlighted CodeBlock: raw HTML shows as text, only http, https, mailto and tel links become links, and each top-level block is memoised so long notes re-render only what changed.
